details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:480-489 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `test_config_contract` reads `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json`, but that file is not in the checkout and no PR diff hunk adds it.
  WHY: CI run 42360066501 fails the step "ChatGPT pool token action tests" with FileNotFoundError, which turns `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` and the aggregate `lint` check red; without a `config_path` input, `scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh` also defaults to the missing path and reports `config_missing`. All three reviewers rate it BLOCKER. They disagree on the fix: z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says the plan makes the config a Phase 2 deliverable (plan line 342) and prefers removing or rewriting the test, while the others expect the file to be added.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:`handleChatgpt` function, `await namespace.get(...).fetch(...)` | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The code calls the Durable Object's `/grant` endpoint using an unverified URL `https://chatgpt-pool.internal/grant`.
  WHY: Nothing explicitly checks that the destination is the Durable Object stub for `CHATGPT_POOL_OBJECT_NAME`, so a misconfigured or compromised environment or object lookup could cause cross-object communication or security misrouting (rated MAJOR).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Issue #8970, requirement 3: "Add `.github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json` (broker URL, audience, etc., per the plan) with `reviewer_slot_enabled: false`. Do not set it to true; go-live is a separate human PR."
  expected_change_site: .github/ai/chatgpt_pool.json (new file; listed in the issue's files_touched grant)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: No PR diff hunk or last-run diff creates the file and it is not in the working tree, `tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:481` / `tests/test_chatgpt_pool_token.py:480-489` (`test_config_contract`) fails with FileNotFoundError in CI run 42360066501, the test expects {schema_version: 1, broker_url: "https://claude-pool-broker.shubhodeep.workers.dev/v1/chatgpt", audience: "coding-workflows-chatgpt-pool", reviewer_slot_enabled: false}, plan Phase 2 step 1 (docs/plans/chatgpt-account-reviewer-trial-plan.md:342-344) lists a different key set (reviewer_slot_enabled, model, replaces, reasoning) that must be reconciled with the test, and four autofix runs in a row have deferred this
- requirement: Issue #8970: "Implement exactly the plan's Phase 1 section. Where it conflicts with this issue, the plan's names, endpoint paths, JSON keys, storage design and file list win." Plan Phase 1 steps 1-2 (docs/plans/chatgpt-account-reviewer-trial-plan.md:288-326) require the `CHATGPT_ACCOUNTS` DO binding (class `ChatgptAccount`), the vars `CHATGPT_GATE` / `CHATGPT_WRITER_REPOSITORY` / `CHATGPT_WRITER_WORKFLOW`, `POST /v1/chatgpt` returning `{account, auth_json}` or `503 chatgpt_pool_empty`, `GET /v1/chatgpt/status`, writer-only `GET`/`PUT /v1/chatgpt/refresh/<NAME>` (audience `coding-workflows-chatgpt-pool-writer`, `404 not_seeded`, `409 generation_conflict` CAS), and reads that keep the `coding-workflows-claude-pool` audience
  expected_change_site: tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts (routing in `handle()` and a new `ChatgptAccount` class) and tools/claude-pool-broker/wrangler.toml (binding and vars)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The diff instead adds a single-credential `ChatgptPoolStore` bound as `CHATGPT_POOL` and seeded from `CHATGPT_POOL_SEED`, the broker refreshes the credential itself via `CHATGPT_REFRESH_URL` / `CHATGPT_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID`, reads use `CHATGPT_AUDIENCE = "coding-workflows-chatgpt-pool"`, `handle()` routes only `/v1/pool` and `CHATGPT_PATH` (`index.ts:636-647`) so `/v1/chatgpt/status` and `/v1/chatgpt/refresh/<NAME>` return 404 (claude-workers' `chatgpt_pool_refresh.py` and the writer workflow would receive that 404), the broker.test.ts routing test asserts 404 for `/v1/chatgpt/grant`, none of `CHATGPT_ACCOUNTS`, `CHATGPT_WRITER_REPOSITORY`, `CHATGPT_WRITER_WORKFLOW`, `generation_conflict`, `not_seeded` or `chatgpt_pool_empty` exists in the source, and an earlier editor run already deferred this redesign
- requirement: Plan Phase 1 step 4 (plan:327-334): the action has a `token` mode that writes `$RUNNER_TEMP/chatgpt-pool/<NAME>/auth.json` with mode 0600 and a `status` mode, with outputs `available`, `reason`, `account` and `codex_home`; the "Done" criterion (plan:248-249) requires `available=false reason=broker_refused_chatgpt_pool_empty` when there are no accounts
  expected_change_site: .github/actions/chatgpt-pool-token/action.yml (new `mode` input, new `account` and `codex_home` outputs) and scripts/chatgpt_pool_token.sh (per-account `<NAME>` subdirectory and status mode)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `action.yml:11-27` declares only the `config_path` input and the outputs `available`, `reason`, `auth_dir`, `auth_file` and `expires_at` (no mode input, no `account` or `codex_home` output), the script writes a single `${pool_dir}/auth.json` with no per-account `<NAME>` directory and no status mode, and the broker never returns `chatgpt_pool_empty`, so `broker_refused_chatgpt_pool_empty` can never occur
- requirement: Plan Phase 1 (plan lines 286–338) requires DO binding `CHATGPT_ACCOUNTS` / class `ChatgptAccount`, routes `POST /v1/chatgpt`, `GET /v1/chatgpt/status`, `GET|PUT /v1/chatgpt/refresh/<NAME>` with writer audience `coding-workflows-chatgpt-pool-writer`, CAS `409 generation_conflict`, `404 not_seeded`, `503 chatgpt_pool_empty`, and action modes `token`/`status` with outputs `available, reason, account, codex_home`
  expected_change_site: Phase 1 broker and action (no specific file named)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer found nothing in the working tree matching these requirements (`.github/ai/` empty, no `chatgpt-pool-token` action dir, no broker source) and concluded that the Phase 1 implementation itself appears absent or uncommitted, not just the config
